svg.text: AI + equity + change: nursing's next decade

g.text: AI HELPS
triage, notes, images,
predictions!
AI LIMITS
bias, hallucinations,
no accountability!
EQUITY
alternatives for
the disconnected!
LEAD CHANGE
super-user + training
+ quick wins!
RESISTANCE?
listen + involve +
support, not force!
AI TODAY: triage chatbots, documentation assistants, image screening, deterioration
predictors,Stock forecasts. AI TOMORROW: more — but the NURSE stays: accountability, touch,
judgment can't be automated (M01 wisdom!).
USE AI WELL: verify EVERY output (hallucinations sound confident!) · never paste identifiable
patient data into public tools (M03 breach!) · know training bias (foreign data ≠ Ghana
patients!) · document AI-assisted decisions as YOURS · stay the decision-maker. Prompting =
TIGER literacy now: specific, context-rich, verified.
EQUITY: every digital service needs a NON-digital path — voice calls, CHPS visits, paper logs,
family-supported routines, local-language audio. Design WITH elders, rural, low-literacy users
— not for them. "Digital first" must never mean "analog never" (M04 check!).
LEADING CHANGE (exam!): 1 WHY-story ("falls hurt — this cuts them") · 2 involve early (ward
champions, sceptics included!) · 3 train hands-on (super-users, elbow support) · 4 quick wins
publicised · 5 feedback loops + fixes · 6 sustain (audit + onboard newcomers). Kotter-lite!
RESISTANCE decoded: "no time" = workflow clash (redesign!) · "it'll fail" = past trauma
(pilot small!) · "patients won't" = projection (ask THEM!) · "I'm too old" = training fear
(buddy up!). Meet feelings, fix systems, celebrate adopters — never mandate-and-abandon.
LINKS: M01 ladder/TIGER · M04 equity · PRO-II M4/M6 QI + leadership.
MANTRA: "AI assists, nurses decide, nobody's left offline."
